children: Overview
U.S. mortgage lender's Q3 adjusted pretax profit beat analyst expectations
Q3 net income fell sharply year-over-year
Servicing segment profitable, production segment posted pretax loss amid industry contraction
Kevin Ryan, currently Chief Strategy Officer, will be CFO from Jan 1
Outlook
Company expects fourth-quarter adjusted ROE to remain near current levels
Company expects mortgage demand to remain subdued due to higher interest rates
Company expects annualized operating expenses to decline by $160 mln by Q1 2027
Result Drivers
SERVICING PROFITABILITY - Co said servicing segment delivered strong profitability, offsetting weakness in production segment, per CEO David Spector
COST REDUCTIONS - Co said it is implementing aggressive expense reductions in response to subdued mortgage demand and higher rates
LOWER ORIGINATION VOLUMES - Co attributed production segment revenue declines to lower refinance volumes and a smaller, more competitive origination market
